description: This file defines the interface and data structures for a TinySRP (Secure Remote Password) client implementation, including the t_client class, its methods, and related constants. It contains function prototypes for SRP negotiation steps and session management.

classes.name: t_client
classes.description: Structure representing an SRP client session, including cryptographic parameters, user credentials, and session state.

methods.name: t_clientopen
methods.description: Initializes a new SRP client session with username and parameters N, g, s.

methods.name: t_clientgenexp
methods.description: Generates a random exponent and computes g raised to that power for SRP.

methods.name: t_clientpasswd
methods.description: Sets the user's password in the client session.

methods.name: t_clientgetkey
methods.description: Computes the session key based on server's exponential y(p).

methods.name: t_clientresponse
methods.description: Computes the session key proof for authentication.

methods.name: t_clientclose
methods.description: Closes the SRP client session and frees resources.
